notes.title: New Price
notes.notes:
Hi all,

Several people have mentioned that they enjoyed the core mechanic of Building Block Heroes, but didn't want to commit to a full-length experience. As a result, I've released a stand-alone expansion for those who want a pick-up-and-play experience!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/857210/Building_Block_Heroes_Rush_Edition/]Building Block Heroes: Rush Edition[/url]

Feel free to check it out if you feel the same! 

In order to include the Rush Edition in a decently-priced bundle, I've also lowered the price of the full game to $5 USD. This way you can pick up both for a discount, so now you've got no excuses not to give the game a try!

notes.title: Now Available on Mac and Linux!
notes.notes:
Hi all,


I'm happy to announce that Building Block Heroes is now available on Mac and Linux! Hopefully you all have as much fun playing this game as I did making it!
